name: transfer
description: Transfer Family is a fully managed service that enables the transfer of files over the File Transfer Protocol (FTP), File Transfer Protocol over SSL (FTPS), or Secure Shell (SSH) File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) directly into and out of Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) or Amazon EFS.

subcommands.name: create-access
subcommands.description: Used by administrators to choose which groups in the directory should have access to upload and download files over the enabled protocols using Transfer Family.

subcommands.name: create-agreement
subcommands.description: Creates an agreement.

subcommands.name: create-connector
subcommands.description: Creates the connector, which captures the parameters for a connection for the AS2 or SFTP protocol.

subcommands.name: create-profile
subcommands.description: Creates the local or partner profile to use for AS2 transfers.

subcommands.name: create-server
subcommands.description: Instantiates an auto-scaling virtual server based on the selected file transfer protocol in Amazon Web Services.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a user and associates them with an existing file transfer protocol-enabled server.

subcommands.name: create-web-app
subcommands.description: Creates a web app based on specified parameters, and returns the ID for the new web app.

subcommands.name: create-workflow
subcommands.description: Allows you to create a workflow with specified steps and step details the workflow invokes after file transfer completes.

subcommands.name: delete-access
subcommands.description: Allows you to delete the access specified in the ServerID and ExternalID parameters.

subcommands.name: delete-agreement
subcommands.description: Delete the agreement that's specified in the provided AgreementId.

subcommands.name: delete-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes the certificate that's specified in the CertificateId parameter.

subcommands.name: delete-connector
subcommands.description: Deletes the connector that's specified in the provided ConnectorId.

subcommands.name: delete-host-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the host key that's specified in the HostKeyId parameter.

subcommands.name: delete-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes the profile that's specified in the ProfileId parameter.

subcommands.name: delete-server
subcommands.description: Deletes the file transfer protocol-enabled server that you specify.

subcommands.name: delete-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Deletes a user's Secure Shell (SSH) public key.

subcommands.name: delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes the user belonging to a file transfer protocol-enabled server you specify.

subcommands.name: delete-web-app
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified web app.

subcommands.name: delete-web-app-customization
subcommands.description: Deletes the WebAppCustomization object that corresponds to the web app ID specified.

subcommands.name: delete-workflow
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: describe-access
subcommands.description: Describes the access that is assigned to the specific file transfer protocol-enabled server, as identified by its ServerId property and its ExternalId.

subcommands.name: describe-agreement
subcommands.description: Describes the agreement that's identified by the AgreementId.

subcommands.name: describe-certificate
subcommands.description: Describes the certificate that's identified by the CertificateId.

subcommands.name: describe-connector
subcommands.description: Describes the connector that's identified by the ConnectorId.

subcommands.name: describe-execution
subcommands.description: You can use DescribeExecution to check the details of the execution of the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: describe-host-key
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the host key that's specified by the HostKeyId and ServerId.

subcommands.name: describe-profile
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the profile that's specified by the ProfileId.

subcommands.name: describe-security-policy
subcommands.description: Describes the security policy that is attached to your server or SFTP connector.

subcommands.name: describe-server
subcommands.description: Describes a file transfer protocol-enabled server that you specify by passing the ServerId parameter.

subcommands.name: describe-user
subcommands.description: Describes the user assigned to the specific file transfer protocol-enabled server, as identified by its ServerId property.

subcommands.name: describe-web-app
subcommands.description: Describes the web app that's identified by WebAppId.

subcommands.name: describe-web-app-customization
subcommands.description: Describes the web app customization object that's identified by WebAppId.

subcommands.name: describe-workflow
subcommands.description: Describes the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: import-certificate
subcommands.description: Imports the signing and encryption certificates that you need to create local (AS2) profiles and partner profiles.

subcommands.name: import-host-key
subcommands.description: Adds a host key to the server that's specified by the ServerId parameter.

subcommands.name: import-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Adds a Secure Shell (SSH) public key to a Transfer Family user identified by a UserName value assigned to the specific file transfer protocol-enabled server, identified by ServerId.

subcommands.name: list-accesses
subcommands.description: Lists the details for all the accesses you have on your server.

subcommands.name: list-agreements
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the agreements for the server that's identified by the ServerId that you supply.

subcommands.name: list-certificates
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the current certificates that have been imported into Transfer Family.

subcommands.name: list-connectors
subcommands.description: Lists the connectors for the specified Region.

subcommands.name: list-executions
subcommands.description: Lists all in-progress executions for the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: list-file-transfer-results
subcommands.description: Returns real-time updates and detailed information on the status of each individual file being transferred in a specific file transfer operation.

subcommands.name: list-host-keys
subcommands.description: Returns a list of host keys for the server that's specified by the ServerId parameter.

subcommands.name: list-profiles
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the profiles for your system.

subcommands.name: list-security-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the security policies that are attached to your servers and SFTP connectors.

subcommands.name: list-servers
subcommands.description: Lists the file transfer protocol-enabled servers that are associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all of the tags associated with the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that you specify.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Lists the users for a file transfer protocol-enabled server that you specify by passing the ServerId parameter.

subcommands.name: list-web-apps
subcommands.description: Lists all web apps associated with your Amazon Web Services account for your current region.

subcommands.name: list-workflows
subcommands.description: Lists all workflows associated with your Amazon Web Services account for your current region.

subcommands.name: send-workflow-step-state
subcommands.description: Sends a callback for asynchronous custom steps.

subcommands.name: start-directory-listing
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the contents of a directory from a remote SFTP server.

subcommands.name: start-file-transfer
subcommands.description: Begins a file transfer between local Amazon Web Services storage and a remote AS2 or SFTP server.

subcommands.name: start-remote-delete
subcommands.description: Deletes a file or directory on the remote SFTP server.

subcommands.name: start-remote-move
subcommands.description: Moves or renames a file or directory on the remote SFTP server.

subcommands.name: start-server
subcommands.description: Changes the state of a file transfer protocol-enabled server from OFFLINE to ONLINE.

subcommands.name: stop-server
subcommands.description: Changes the state of a file transfer protocol-enabled server from ONLINE to OFFLINE.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Attaches a key-value pair to a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: test-connection
subcommands.description: Tests whether your SFTP connector is set up successfully.

subcommands.name: test-identity-provider
subcommands.description: If the IdentityProviderType of a file transfer protocol-enabled server is AWS_DIRECTORY_SERVICE or API_Gateway, tests whether your identity provider is set up successfully.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Detaches a key-value pair from a resource, as identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: update-access
subcommands.description: Allows you to update parameters for the access specified in the ServerID and ExternalID parameters.

subcommands.name: update-agreement
subcommands.description: Updates some of the parameters for an existing agreement.

subcommands.name: update-certificate
subcommands.description: Updates the active and inactive dates for a certificate.

subcommands.name: update-connector
subcommands.description: Updates some of the parameters for an existing connector.

subcommands.name: update-host-key
subcommands.description: Updates the description for the host key that's specified by the ServerId and HostKeyId parameters.

subcommands.name: update-profile
subcommands.description: Updates some of the parameters for an existing profile.

subcommands.name: update-server
subcommands.description: Updates the file transfer protocol-enabled server's properties after that server has been created.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Assigns new properties to a user.

subcommands.name: update-web-app
subcommands.description: Assigns new properties to a web app.

subcommands.name: update-web-app-customization
subcommands.description: Assigns new customization properties to a web app.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: server-offline
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query Server.State returns OFFLINE when polling with ``describe-server``.

subcommands.name: server-online
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query Server.State returns ONLINE when polling with ``describe-server``.
